text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan
Pengangkutan Awam Darat (Pengkompaunan Kesalahan) 2011.

(2)  Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 17 Ogos 2011.

Kesalahan yang boleh dikompaun

2. Kesalahan-kesalahan yang berikut ditetapkan sebagai kesalahan yang boleh
dikompaun:

(a) kesalahan di bawah seksyen 152, 199, 200, 202 dan 206 da n subseksyen
14(2), 22(3), 45(6), 46(2), 48(2), 49(2), 71(2), 72(6), 73(3), 75(7), 77(4),
77(5), 78(2), 81(1), 82(3), 151(1), 151(2) dan 203(2) Akta; dan

(b) kesalahan terhadap Kaedah -Kaedah Bas Sekolah (Warna dan Tanda)
1987 [P.U. (A) 437/1987].

Pengkompaunan kesalahan

3. (1) Suatu tawaran untuk mengkompaun kesalahan oleh orang yang
dinyatakan dalam subseksyen 235(2) Akta hendaklah dibuat dalam Borang 1 Jadual.

(2) Seseorang yang menyetuju  terima suatu tawaran untuk mengkompaun
kesalahan di bawah subper aturan (1) hendaklah mengemukakan bayaran bagi
kompaun itu dengan menggunakan Borang 2 Jadual.

Pembayaran kompaun

4. (1)  Apa-apa pembayaran kompaun berkenaan dengan suatu kesalahan yang
dikompaun hendaklah dibuat secara tunai atau melalui kiriman wang, wang pos atau
draf bank yang kena dibayar kepada Kumpulan Wang SPAD dan dipalang dengan
perkataan "Akaun Penerima Sahaja".

(2)  Apa-apa pembayaran yang dibuat-

(a) secara tunai hendaklah diserahkan sendiri; atau

(b) melalui selain tunai boleh diserahkan sendiri atau dihantar melalui
pos berdaftar prabayar yang dialamatkan,

ke pejabat orang yang membuat tawaran untuk mengkompaun itu.

(3) Orang yang membuat tawaran untuk mengkompaun kesalahan di bawah
subperaturan 3(1) hendaklah mengeluarkan s uatu resi t rasmi bagi bayaran kompaun
kepada orang yang kepadanya tawaran untuk mengkompaun itu dibuat.

Penyampaian tawaran bertulis, dsb., melalui pos

5. Jika suatu tawaran bertulis atau dokumen lain disampaikan melalui pos
berdaftar prabayar, tawaran bertulis at au dokumen lain itu hendaklah disifatkan
sebagai telah diserahkan pada masa tawaran bertulis atau dokumen lain itu akan
diserahkan dalam perjalanan biasa pos.

Pembatalan

6. Kaedah-Kaedah Lembaga Pelesenan Kenderaan Perdagangan (Pengkompaunan
Kesalahan) 2 003 [ P.U. (A) 54/2003 ] dibatalkan berkenaan dengan pemakaiannya bagi
Semenanjung Malaysia.

LAND PUBLIC TRANSPORT ACT 2010
LAND PUBLIC TRANSPORT (COMPOUNDING OF OFFENCES) REGULATIONS 2011
IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 252(1)(e) of the Land Public
Transport Act 2010 [Act 715], the Minister makes the following regulations:
Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Land Public Transport
(Compounding of Offences) Regulations 2011.
(2) These Regulations come into operation on 17 August 2011.
Compoundable offences
2. The following offences are prescribed to be compoundable offences:
(a) offences under sections 152, 199, 200, 202 and 206 and subsections
14(2), 22(3), 45(6), 46(2), 48(2), 49(2), 71(2), 72(6), 73(3), 75(7), 77(4),
77(5), 78(2), 81(1), 82(3), 151(1), 151(2) and 203(2) of the Act; and

(b) offences against the School Bus (Colour and Markings) Rules 1987
[P.U. (A) 437/1987].

Compounding of offence
3. (1) An offer to compound an offence by the person specified in subsection
235(2) of the Act shall be made in Form 1 of the Schedule.
(2) A person who accepts an offer to compound  an offence under
subregulation (1) shall furnish payment for the compound by using Form 2 of the
Schedule.
Payment of compound
4. (1)  Any payment of compound in respect of a com pounded offence shall be
made in cash or by money order, postal order or banker's draft made payable to the
Kumpulan Wang SPAD and crossed with the words "Account Payee Only".

(2)  Any payment made-

(a) in cash shall be delivered personally; or

(b) by other than cash may be delivered personally or sent by pr epaid
registered post addressed,

to the office of the person who made the offer to compound.
(3) The person who made an offer to compound an offence under
subregulation 3(1) shall issue an  official receipt for the payment of compound to the
person to whom the offer to compound was made.
Service of written offer, etc., by post
5. Where a written offer or other document is served by prepaid registered post,
that written offer or other document shall be deemed to have been delivered at the time
when that written offer or other document would have been delivered in the ordinary
course of the post.

Revocation
6. The Commercial Vehicles Licensing Board (Compounding of Offences) Rules
2003 [ P.U. (A) 54/20 03] are revoked in respect of their application to Peninsular
Malaysia.
